role.terseLabel: Certificates of Deposit, at Carrying Value
role.label: Certificates of Deposit, at Carrying Value
role.documentation: A savings certificate entitling the Entity (that is, bearer) to receive interest at an established maturity date, based upon a fixed interest rate. A certificate of deposit may be issued in any denomination. Certificates of deposit are generally issued by commercial banks and, therefore, insured by the FDIC (up to the prescribed limit). Certificates of deposit generally restrict holders from withdrawing funds on demand without the incurrence of penalties. Generally, only certificates of deposit with original maturities of three months or less qualify as cash equivalents. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. As a related example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

role.documentation: Amount of issuance costs recognized in a share-lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, after deduction of accumulated amortization or the effects of subsequent adjustments.

role.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
role.documentation: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

role.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
role.documentation: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

role.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
role.documentation: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

role.label: Deferred Revenue, Noncurrent
role.documentation: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

role.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
role.documentation: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets Deferred Foreign Tax Credits
role.documentation: Deferred Tax Assets Deferred Foreign Tax Credits

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Deferred Income
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from deferred income.

role.negatedTotalLabel: Total deferred tax assets before valuation allowance
role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets Intangible Assets
role.documentation: Deferred Tax Assets, Intangible Assets

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Lease liability
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from lease liability

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net
role.documentation: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Not Subject to Expiration
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards that are not subject to expiration dates.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
role.documentation: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets Other Assets
role.documentation: Deferred Tax Assets, Other.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Property, Plant and Equipment
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense
role.documentation: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowances, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences from reserves and accruals, compensation and benefit costs, and other provisions, reserves, and allowances.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensation and benefits costs.

role.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Intangible Assets
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets other than goodwill.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities Lease right-of-use asset
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from lease right-of-use asset.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities Other Liabilities
role.documentation: The cumulative amount of the estimated future tax effects attributable to other temporary differences.

role.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan Employee Contribution Percentage
role.documentation: Defined Benefit Plan, Employee Contribution, Percentage

role.terseLabel: Depreciation and amortization expense for property and equipment
role.label: Depreciation
role.documentation: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

role.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
role.documentation: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

role.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
role.documentation: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

role.label: Derivative Asset
role.documentation: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

role.terseLabel: Investment, indexed to Market Indices Fair Value
role.label: Derivative Contract Indexed To Market Indices Fair Value
role.documentation: Derivative Contract Indexed to Market Indices, Fair Value

role.label: Derivative Contract [Domain]
role.documentation: Financial instrument or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

role.label: Derivative Asset, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, before Offset
role.documentation: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

role.label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, before Offset
role.documentation: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

role.terseLabel: Gain (Loss) Recognized in Income on Derivative
role.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

role.terseLabel: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain (Loss), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
role.label: Derivative Instrument, Gain (Loss) Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion, Net
role.documentation: Derivative Instrument, Gain (Loss) Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion, Net

role.label: Derivative Instrument [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of derivative contract.

role.label: Hedging Relationship [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of hedging relationship.

role.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about the location and amount of derivative instruments and nonderivative instruments designated as hedging instruments reported before netting adjustments, and the amount of gain (loss) on derivative instruments and nonderivative instruments designated and qualified as hedging instruments.

role.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.terseLabel: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net
role.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net
role.documentation: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

role.label: Derivative Liability
role.documentation: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

role.label: Derivative, Notional Amount
role.documentation: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payment on derivative.

role.label: Derivatives, Fair Value [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Derivatives, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for its derivative instruments and hedging activities.

role.label: Designated as Hedging Instrument [Member]
role.documentation: Derivative instrument designated as hedging instrument under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

role.label: Developmental Licensees [Member]
role.documentation: Developmental Licensees [Member]

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: Disposal Group Classification [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by disposal group classification.

role.label: Disposal Group Classification [Domain]
role.documentation: Component or group of components disposed of, including but not limited to, disposal group held-for-sale or disposed of by sale, disposed of by means other than sale, and discontinued operations.

role.label: Dividends, Cash
role.documentation: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

role.label: Document Annual Report
role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true only for a form used as an annual report.

role.label: Document Fiscal Period Focus
role.documentation: Fiscal period values are FY, Q1, Q2, and Q3. 1st, 2nd and 3rd quarter 10-Q or 10-QT statements have value Q1, Q2, and Q3 respectively, with 10-K, 10-KT or other fiscal year statements having FY.

role.label: Document Fiscal Year Focus
role.documentation: This is focus fiscal year of the document report in YYYY format. For a 2006 annual report, which may also provide financial information from prior periods, fiscal 2006 should be given as the fiscal year focus. Example: 2006.

role.label: Document Period End Date
role.documentation: For the EDGAR submission types of Form 8-K: the date of the report, the date of the earliest event reported; for the EDGAR submission types of Form N-1A: the filing date; for all other submission types: the end of the reporting or transition period. The format of the date is YYYY-MM-DD.

role.label: Document Transition Report
role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true only for a form used as a transition report.

role.label: Document Type
role.documentation: The type of document being provided (such as 10-K, 10-Q, 485BPOS, etc). The document type is limited to the same value as the supporting SEC submission type, or the word 'Other'.

role.label: Documents Incorporated by Reference [Text Block]
role.documentation: Documents incorporated by reference.

role.label: Dynamic Yield [Member]
role.documentation: Dynamic Yield

role.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
role.documentation: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

role.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
role.documentation: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

role.label: Earnings Per Share, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for computing basic and diluted earnings or loss per share for each class of common stock and participating security. Addresses all significant policy factors, including any antidilutive items that have been excluded from the computation and takes into account stock dividends, splits and reverse splits that occur after the balance sheet date of the latest reporting period but before the issuance of the financial statements.

role.terseLabel: Effect of exchange rates on cash and equivalents
role.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalent, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalent, Continuing Operation
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

role.terseLabel: Earnings per common share-diluted (in dollars per share)
role.label: Effect Of Share Based Compensation On Net Income Per Share
role.documentation: The effect of share-based compensation expense on net income per common share-diluted

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

role.terseLabel: Statutory U.S. federal income tax rate
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Percent
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the income tax rates.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation Foreign Derived Intangible Income
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, FDII, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of reported income tax benefit from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to foreign-derived intangible income (FDII).

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation Foreign Derived Intangible Income
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation Foreign Derived Intangible Income
role.documentation: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation Foreign Derived Intangible Income

role.terseLabel: Foreign income taxed at different rates
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of the country of domicile.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, GILTI, Amount
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, GILTI, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI).

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Global Intangible Low-Taxed Income, Percent
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, GILTI, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI).

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation [Line Items]
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Percent
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation of Foreign Earnings, Percent
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation of Foreign Earnings, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the repatriation of foreign earnings.

role.terseLabel: State income taxes, net of related federal income tax benefit
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to state and local income tax expense (benefit), net of federal tax expense (benefit).

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about income tax rate reconciliation between amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) attributable to continuing operation to amount of income tax expense(benefit) that would result from applying statutory federal (national) tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax contingencies. Includes, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Other, Percent
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Other, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other income tax contingencies.

role.terseLabel: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Percent
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not limited to, research credit, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, and other tax credits.

role.terseLabel: Unrecognized compensation cost related to nonvested share-based compensation
role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of cost not yet recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Period for Recognition
role.documentation: Weighted-average period over which cost not yet recognized is expected to be recognized for award under share-based payment arrangement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Entity Address, Address Line One
role.documentation: Address Line 1 such as Attn, Building Name, Street Name

role.label: Entity Address, City or Town
role.documentation: Name of the City or Town

role.label: Entity Address, Postal Zip Code
role.documentation: Code for the postal or zip code

role.label: Entity Address, State or Province
role.documentation: Name of the state or province.

role.label: Entity Central Index Key
role.documentation: A unique 10-digit SEC-issued value to identify entities that have filed disclosures with the SEC. It is commonly abbreviated as CIK.

role.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
role.documentation: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

role.label: Entity Current Reporting Status
role.documentation: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' whether registrants (1) have filed all reports required to be filed by Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 during the preceding 12 months (or for such shorter period that registrants were required to file such reports), and (2) have been subject to such filing requirements for the past 90 days. This information should be based on the registrant's current or most recent filing containing the related disclosure.

role.label: Entity [Domain]
role.documentation: All the names of the entities being reported upon in a document. Any legal structure used to conduct activities or to hold assets. Some examples of such structures are corporations, partnerships, limited liability companies, grantor trusts, and other trusts. This item does not include business and geographical segments which are included in the geographical or business segments domains.

role.label: Entity Emerging Growth Company
role.documentation: Indicate if registrant meets the emerging growth company criteria.

role.label: Entity File Number
role.documentation: Commission file number. The field allows up to 17 characters. The prefix may contain 1-3 digits, the sequence number may contain 1-8 digits, the optional suffix may contain 1-4 characters, and the fields are separated with a hyphen.

role.label: Entity Filer Category
role.documentation: Indicate whether the registrant is one of the following: Large Accelerated Filer, Accelerated Filer, Non-accelerated Filer. Definitions of these categories are stated in Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act. This information should be based on the registrant's current or most recent filing containing the related disclosure.

role.terseLabel: Entity Incorporation, State or Country Code
role.label: Entity Incorporation, State or Country Code
role.documentation: Two-character EDGAR code representing the state or country of incorporation.

role.label: Entity Interactive Data Current
role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true when the registrant has submitted electronically every Interactive Data File required to be submitted pursuant to Rule 405 of Regulation S-T during the preceding 12 months (or for such shorter period that the registrant was required to submit such files).

role.label: Entity Operated Units [Member]
role.documentation: Units that are owned and operated by the entity (franchisor).

role.label: Entity Public Float
role.documentation: The aggregate market value of the voting and non-voting common equity held by non-affiliates computed by reference to the price at which the common equity was last sold, or the average bid and asked price of such common equity, as of the last business day of the registrant's most recently completed second fiscal quarter.

role.label: Entity Registrant Name
role.documentation: The exact name of the entity filing the report as specified in its charter, which is required by forms filed with the SEC.

role.label: Entity Shell Company
role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true when the registrant is a shell company as defined in Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act.

role.label: Entity Small Business
role.documentation: Indicates that the company is a Smaller Reporting Company (SRC).

role.label: Entity Tax Identification Number
role.documentation: The Tax Identification Number (TIN), also known as an Employer Identification Number (EIN), is a unique 9-digit value assigned by the IRS.

role.label: Entity Voluntary Filers
role.documentation: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is not required to file reports pursuant to Section 13 or Section 15(d) of the Act.

role.label: Entity Well-known Seasoned Issuer
role.documentation: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is a well-known seasoned issuer, as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act. Is used on Form Type: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q/A, 20-F/A, 6-K/A, N-CSR, N-Q, N-1A.

role.terseLabel: Entity Wide Revenue Major Customer [Line Items]
role.label: Revenue, Major Customer [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Equipment [Member]
role.documentation: Tangible personal property used to produce goods and services.

role.label: Equity Component [Domain]
role.documentation: Components of equity are the parts of the total Equity balance including that which is allocated to common, preferred, treasury stock, retained earnings, etc.

role.label: Equity Contract [Member]
role.documentation: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to share prices.

role.label: Equity [Member]
role.documentation: Trading in a derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to share prices.

role.label: Equity Method Investee [Member]
role.documentation: An entity that issued voting stock held by an investor and that is accounted for under the equity method of accounting by the investor.

role.terseLabel: Equity Method Investment, Difference Between Carrying Amount and Underlying Equity
role.label: Equity Method Investment, Difference Between Carrying Amount and Underlying Equity
role.documentation: Difference between amount at which an investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting is carried (reported) on the balance sheet and amount of underlying equity in net assets the reporting Entity has in the investee.

role.label: Equity Method Investment, Ownership Percentage
role.documentation: The percentage of ownership of common stock or equity participation in the investee accounted for under the equity method of accounting.

role.terseLabel: Equity Method Investment, Quoted Market Value
role.label: Equity Method Investment, Quoted Market Value
role.documentation: This item represents the aggregate value of each identified investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting based on the quoted market price for those investments in common stock for which a quoted market price is available.

role.label: Equity Method Investments
role.documentation: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

role.label: Equity Method Investments and Joint Ventures [Abstract]

role.terseLabel: Equity Method Investments and Joint Ventures Disclosure
role.label: Equity Method Investments and Joint Ventures Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for equity method investments and joint ventures. Equity method investments are investments that give the investor the ability to exercise significant influence over the operating and financial policies of an investee. Joint ventures are entities owned and operated by a small group of businesses as a separate and specific business or project for the mutual benefit of the members of the group.

role.label: Escalation Timing
role.documentation: Escalation Timing

role.label: Estimates And Assumptions Policy [Text Block]
role.documentation: Estimates And Assumptions, Policy

role.verboseLabel: Fair Value, Assets and Liabilities Measured on Recurring and Nonrecurring Basis
role.label: Fair Value, Assets and Liabilities Measured on Recurring and Nonrecurring Basis [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.terseLabel: Fair Value, Assets and Liabilities Measured on Recurring and Nonrecurring Basis
role.label: Fair Value, Recurring and Nonrecurring [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about asset and liability measured at fair value on recurring and nonrecurring basis.

role.label: Asset Class [Domain]
role.documentation: Class of asset.

role.label: Asset Class [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by class of asset.

role.label: Fair Value Hierarchy and NAV [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by level within fair value hierarchy and fair value measured at net asset value per share as practical expedient.

role.label: Liability Class [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by class of liability.

role.label: Measurement Frequency [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by measurement frequency.

role.label: Fair Value Hedging [Member]
role.documentation: A hedge of the exposure to changes in the fair value of a recognized asset or liability, or of an unrecognized firm commitment, that are attributable to a particular risk.

role.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 1 [Member]
role.documentation: Quoted prices in active markets for identical assets or liabilities that the reporting entity can access at the measurement date.

role.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 2 [Member]
role.documentation: Inputs other than quoted prices included within level 1 that are observable for an asset or liability, either directly or indirectly, including, but not limited to, quoted prices for similar assets or liabilities in active markets, or quoted prices for identical or similar assets or liabilities in inactive markets.

role.label: Fair Value by Liability Class [Domain]
role.documentation: Represents classes of liabilities measured and disclosed at fair value.

role.label: Measurement Frequency [Domain]
role.documentation: Measurement frequency.

role.terseLabel: Fair Value, Measurements, Fair Value Hierarchy [Domain]
role.label: Fair Value Hierarchy and NAV [Domain]
role.documentation: Categories used to prioritize the inputs to valuation techniques to measure fair value.

role.label: Fair Value, Recurring [Member]
role.documentation: Frequent fair value measurement. Includes, but is not limited to, fair value adjustment for impairment of asset, liability or equity, frequently measured at fair value.

role.label: Fair Value of Financial Instruments, Policy [Policy Text Block]

role.documentation: Period from grant date that an equity-based award expires, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Term
role.documentation: Expected term of award under share-based payment arrangement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value
role.documentation: Amount of difference between fair value of the underlying shares reserved for issuance and exercise price of vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
role.documentation: Weighted average remaining contractual term for vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable or convertible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
role.documentation: Weighted average remaining contractual term for option awards outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Shares, Issued
role.documentation: Number of shares of stock issued as of the balance sheet date, including shares that had been issued and were previously outstanding but which are now held in the treasury.

role.label: Short-Term Debt, Type [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of short-term debt arrangement.

role.label: Short-Term Debt, Type [Domain]
role.documentation: Type of short-term debt arrangement, such as notes, line of credit, commercial paper, asset-based financing, project financing, letter of credit financing.

role.terseLabel: Reclassification of short-term obligations to long-term obligations
role.label: Short Term Obligations Reclassification To Long Term Obligations
role.documentation: Short Term Obligations Reclassification to Long Term Obligations

role.label: Significant Accounting Policies [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for all significant accounting policies of the reporting entity.

role.label: Special Termination Benefits [Member]
role.documentation: Special benefits offered to employees to terminate employment.

role.label: Segments [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by business segments.

role.label: Equity Components [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by component of equity.

role.label: Statement [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Statement [Table]
role.documentation: Presentation of information about comprehensive income, income, other comprehensive income, financial position, cash flows, and shareholders' equity.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Member]
role.documentation: Share-based payment arrangement in which award of equity shares are granted. Arrangement includes, but is not limited to, grantor incurring liability for product and service based on price of its shares.

role.terseLabel: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
role.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
role.documentation: Number, after forfeiture, of shares or units issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes shares or units issued under employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period
role.documentation: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

role.terseLabel: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
role.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
role.documentation: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

role.label: Equity Option [Member]
role.documentation: Contracts conveying rights, but not obligations, to buy or sell a specific quantity of stock at a specified price during a specified period (an American option) or at a specified date (a European option).

role.label: Equity, Attributable to Parent
role.documentation: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

role.label: Subsequent Event Type [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by event that occurred after the balance sheet date but before financial statements are issued or available to be issued.

role.label: Subsequent Event Type [Domain]
role.documentation: Event that occurred after the balance sheet date but before financial statements are issued or available to be issued.

role.label: Subsequent Events [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for significant events or transactions that occurred after the balance sheet date through the date the financial statements were issued or the date the financial statements were available to be issued. Examples include: the sale of a capital stock issue, purchase of a business, settlement of litigation, catastrophic loss, significant foreign exchange rate changes, loans to insiders or affiliates, and transactions not in the ordinary course of business.

role.label: Supplemental Benefit Plan Liability
role.documentation: Liability for supplemental benefit plans that allow participants to make tax-deferred contributions and receive company-provided allocations that cannot be made under the Profit Sharing and Savings Plan because of IRS limitations.

role.label: Tax Impact of Intercompany Transactions
role.documentation: Tax Impact of Intercompany Transactions

role.label: Tax Jurisdiction of Domicile [Extensible Enumeration]
role.documentation: Indicates tax jurisdiction of domicile.

role.label: Total Other Assets
role.documentation: Total Other Assets

role.label: Trading Symbol
role.documentation: Trading symbol of an instrument as listed on an exchange.

role.label: Treasury Lock [Member]
role.documentation: Customized agreement that fixes the yield or price on a specified treasury security for a specific period.

role.label: Treasury Stock, Common [Member]
role.documentation: Previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

role.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Shares
role.documentation: Number of previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

role.label: Treasury Stock, Shares, Acquired
role.documentation: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and are being held in treasury.

role.negatedTerseLabel: Common stock in treasury, at cost; 950.0 and 945.4 million shares
role.label: Treasury Stock, Value
role.documentation: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

role.label: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Cost Method
role.documentation: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the cost method.

role.label: Type of Restructuring [Domain]
role.documentation: Identification of the types of restructuring costs.

role.label: U.S. Market [Member]
role.documentation: U.S (United States) Market

role.label: United Kingdom [Member]
role.documentation: United Kingdom

role.terseLabel: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedges, Pretax, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
role.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedges, Pretax, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
role.documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the increase or decrease in fair value of interest rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments, which was recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge was determined to be effective.

role.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits
role.documentation: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

role.negatedTerseLabel: Decreases for positions taken in prior years
role.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
role.documentation: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

role.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
role.documentation: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

role.terseLabel: Increases for positions related to the current year
role.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
role.documentation: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

role.terseLabel: Increases for positions taken in prior years
role.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
role.documentation: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

role.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations
role.documentation: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from lapses of applicable statutes of limitations.

role.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits that Would Impact Effective Tax Rate
role.documentation: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate.

role.label: Unused lines of Credit [Member]
role.documentation: The unused portion of a line of credit that is available to the borrower to withdrawn upon.

role.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
role.documentation: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

role.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
role.documentation: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.
